faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RLDA Homeopathy Doctor (Consultant) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the RLDA Homeopathy Doctor (Consultant) position is 16th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Homeopathy Doctor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BHMS Degree of not less than four years duration and have at least five years of experience in the Homeopathic system of medicines with a valid registration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Homeopathy Doctor (Consultant) post is 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Homeopathy Doctor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by sending their complete application along with required documents via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Homeopathy Doctor (Consultant) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Homeopathy Doctor (Consultant) position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Rail Land Development Authority (RLDA).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.
